svg.title: Civil detection buyers differ from authorized aircraft integrators
svg.desc: Civil facilities may buy sensing, alerting and escalation; authorized mitigation integrators may buy physical systems. Only integrators whose selected system includes an interceptor might need an ESC. Detection does not determine intent or grant authority. Authority is actor- and jurisdiction-specific; this diagram is not legal advice. Sources: FAA UAS detection guidance https://www.faa.gov/airports/new_entrants/uas_detection_mitigation_response; FBI testimony 15 April 2026 https://www.fbi.gov/news/speeches-and-testimony/statement-of-special-agent-in-charge-douglas-olson-to-senate-appropriations; Federal Register rule 6 July 2026 https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-07-06/pdf/2026-13609.pdf; ledger E18-E20.

g.text: TWO BUYER LISTS · TWO DIFFERENT JOBS
May procure a physical mitigation system
Detection-site counts do not size controller orders.
Authority depends on actor, system and jurisdiction.
Sources: FAA guidance; FBI testimony; 2026 rule
